def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    rb, cb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h], [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1]) for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])) == 2 else bg for j in range(len(cb)-1)] for i in range(len(rb)-1)]
